content_zh: 影像装置（多通道影像，喜马拉雅盐砖，囊谦红盐，水泥白，LCD屏幕，牦牛毛织物，铜质铃铛，金属立柱）
技术参与：交互实现

人的内在意识空间和外在普遍空间之间的同构性，在《12冥想屋-盐》中被一种独特的地质产物搭建起来。囊谦红盐形成于几千万年的沉积、造山、抬升与自涌的运动，是看似坚实的大地在更大时空尺度中进行流动与交融的物质结晶，粉色岩盐块不但暗示了艺术家乔美的家乡地理坐标，其成分也指向人的感官知觉和迁徙交互经验的基本元素。整个装置作品以一种心理地理的方式进入，制造出能够同时限制并激发具身知觉经验的层层结界空间。十二屏影像来自于乔美导演的长片电影项目《小戒指》的拍摄延展内容“12个瞬间”，其中有冬日囊谦的广袤地景与日常，也有在片中出镜的多位艺术家们的表演与作品式自白的段落。
作品于2026年西岸艺术与设计博览会“现场”（xiàn chǎng）单元呈现。
content_en: Video Installation (multi-channel video, Himalayan salt bricks, red salt, cement, LCD screen, yak-wool fabric, copper bells, metal columns)

In '12 Meditation Chambers: Salt', the isomorphism between the inner human consciousness and the external, universal space is constructed through a unique geological formation. Nangqên red salt was formed through tens of millions of years of sedimentation, orogeny, uplift and self-flow; it is the material crystallisation of the seemingly solid earth as it flows and intermingles on a larger spatio-temporal scale. The pink rock salt blocks not only allude to the geographical coordinates of the artist Chakme’s hometown, but their composition also points to the fundamental elements of human sensory perception and the experiences of migration and interaction. The entire installation adopts a psychogeographical approach, creating layered, boundary-like spaces that simultaneously constrain and stimulate embodied sensory experiences. The twelve video screens feature footage from '12 Moments', an extension of the filming for Chakme’s feature-length film project 'The Little Ring'; these include vast winter landscapes and everyday scenes from Nangqên, as well as segments featuring performances and confessional monologues by the various artists who appear in the film.
The work is presented as part of the 'xiàn chǎng' sector at West Bund Art & Design 2026.
